text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Kept you waiting, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Glad you could make it, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So, what in the world are you playing at? 
Showing up here ready for a serious run—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Ain't it obvious? You 'n me are havin' a 
match right now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The course goes around clockwise from here 
once, and finishes right over there. In 
distance... that's 2,500 meters.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...! It can't be—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's make this our very own "Arima 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally the slopes and all are 
totally different from the real course. 
But still, you can at least get a feel for 
the distance, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I'm down in wins against ya. And yet, 
you're aiming for the Tokyo Daishoten this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Since you won't be at the upcoming Arima 
Kinen, now's my only chance to settle the 
score this year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Will you accept this challenge? ...Inari 
One."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh— The answer to that's already set in 
stone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's put on an "Arima Kinen" of our very 
own! Show 'em what you've got, "White 
Lightning", Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then—shall we get started? On OUR 
Grand Prix!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Gaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Just what I'd expect from you, Tama...! 
Your running's gotten even sharper than 
before...!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—What's the matter, Inari?! Is that all 
the legs that beat me have got?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here!! The real deal starts 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—Heh, you got me...! I'm burning up, 
aching all over! I can't help but laugh, 
it's so damn fun!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Tama! I'll never, ever forget running 
with you today!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I don't wanna forget...!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *gasp*... *pant*...—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I'll have to talk about it in front of 
everyone eventually, so I'll tell you now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y'know... once the next Arima Kinen is 
over... I'm thinking about taking a little 
break.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I'm really glad I got to run 
with you today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Inari. I'll never, ever forget 
running with ya today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tama—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Make sure you come back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...I still haven't run enough with you. 
If we don't throw an even bigger festival, 
I won't be satisfied! So—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep the track fired up red-hot, 
so you'll be itching like crazy to get 
back to racing!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, that's grand!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be looking forward to it. 
To the moment you warm up the crowd for 
us—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"—You'd better give it everything you've 
got, Inari! From here on out, I won't 
forgive any half-assed running!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —You betcha!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I should be the one thanking you, damn it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Your run, your fiery spirit... I felt 
every single bit of it in my bones...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross... You truly are Japan's 
greatest "White Lightning"...!
